{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01PreKPMsSw7pdd7Dy71mz7y","type":"tool_result","content":"---\ncmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)\nproject(floydwarshall_benchmark)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\nadd_executable(floydwarshall floydwarshall.cpp)\n\n# Enable optimizations\ntarget_compile_options(floydwarshall PRIVATE -O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra)\n\n# OpenMP is required; configuration fails if it is unavailable\nfind_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)\n\n# Link math library and OpenMP runtime\ntarget_link_libraries(floydwarshall m OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX)\n---\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    unsigned int* const d = dist.data();\n    unsigned int* const p = path.data();\n\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k. The thread team is created once; the\n    // implicit barrier at the end of each worksharing loop orders the k steps.\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // Row k is not modified during step k (its diagonal entry is zero and\n        // distances are unsigned), so every source row i can be relaxed\n        // concurrently. Each thread writes only the rows it owns.\n        #pragma omp for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            if (i == k) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            unsigned int* __restrict distRow = d + i * numNodes;\n            unsigned int* __restrict pathRow = p + i * numNodes;\n            const unsigned int* __restrict kRow = d + k * numNodes;\n\n            // distIK is invariant across j: element (i,k) is only rewritten\n            // with a value that is not smaller than itself\n            const unsigned int distIK = distRow[k];\n\n            // For each destination node j. Both stores are unconditional so\n            // the loop vectorizes; unchanged entries are written back as-is.\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = distRow[j];\n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + kRow[j];\n                const bool better = newDist < distIJ;\n\n                distRow[j] = better ? newDist : distIJ;\n                pathRow[j] = better ? static_cast<unsigned int>(k) : pathRow[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"be9a2cd4-4579-4b80-82b7-121cb3f643b0","uuid":"d2d3f026-eebd-4cd9-b606-8a7d89486471","timestamp":"2026-10-13T07:35:07.321Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"---\ncmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)\nproject(floydwarshall_benchmark)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\nadd_executable(floydwarshall floydwarshall.cpp)\n\n# Enable optimizations\ntarget_compile_options(floydwarshall PRIVATE -O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra)\n\n# OpenMP is required; configuration fails if it is unavailable\nfind_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)\n\n# Link math library and OpenMP runtime\ntarget_link_libraries(floydwarshall m OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX)\n---\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    unsigned int* const d = dist.data();\n    unsigned int* const p = path.data();\n\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyrJ51sCJkhZs2QRgc1o","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Floyd-Warshall kernel now runs in parallel with OpenMP, and output and path matrix are identical to the original. Only `floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp` and `floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt` changed, and the executable name is unchanged.\n\n**What changed**\n- **Kernel:** one parallel region wraps the `k` loop, and a `#pragma omp for schedule(static)` splits the source rows `i` across threads. Row `k` never changes during step `k` (its diagonal is zero and distances are unsigned), so rows can be relaxed concurrently with no races.\n- **Inner loop:** the two stores are now unconditional selects, so GCC vectorizes it. The `i == k` row is skipped because it has no writes in that step. `distIK` is hoisted for the same reason.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)` and `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX` are linked. OpenMP is unconditional, with no `#ifdef` guards. `-O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra` and the `m` link are kept.\n- **Not parallelized:** the RNG initialization stays serial so the generated matrix is unchanged. The init and validation passes are O(n²) or smaller and not timed.\n\n**Verification**\n- Output (hash, samples, min/max/sum, validation) matches the original for n = 1, 2, 3, 7, 64, 100, 255, 512, 777, 1024 at 1–256 threads.\n- The full path matrix (not printed by the program) is identical to the original for n = 5, 100, 333, 512 at 1, 7 and 256 threads. I checked this with scratch copies in `/tmp`.\n- Builds cleanly with no warnings under `-Wall -Wextra`.\n\n**Timings** (computation time only, shared box with load ~30 from other users, so numbers are noisy)\n\n| n | original | 1 thread | 8 threads | 32 threads | 128 threads (best of 3) |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 512 | 165 ms | 44 ms | 11 ms | 12 ms | 16 ms |\n| 2048 | 9483 ms | 3100 ms | 405 ms | 148 ms | 145 ms |\n\nAt n = 2048 that is about 65× over the original. Past roughly 128 threads it stops improving: the machine has 128 physical cores, and the 256 logical CPUs include SMT siblings and span two sockets. At 256 threads the best-of-three time was 250 ms. The matrix is streamed once per `k`, so the kernel is memory-bound at these sizes. Tiled Floyd-Warshall would help further, but it would be a larger rewrite, so I didn't do it here.\n\nI did not commit anything."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1629,"cache_read_input_tokens":31478,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1629},"output_tokens":5,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"be9a2cd4-4579-4b80-82b7-121cb3f643b0","uuid":"e004302b-0048-4411-b48b-707e05c8192e","timestamp":"2026-10-13T07:35:12.972Z","request_id":"req_011CfyrJ4hmAgN3KrUuSJuXs"}
